g.title: CINV
g.text: Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting — QSP mechanistic map
Every antiemetic subtracts ONE additive term from the emetic drive; every endpoint is exp(-∫hazard).
Additivity is exact only in the DRIVE; the saturating hazard and the exponential endpoint destroy it, which is where all reported synergy comes from.
